steps.description: Create a branch called issue-lint-workflow from main in mcpmark-eval/mcpmark-cicd.

Add .github/workflows/issue-lint.yml on the branch: workflow name 'Issue Lint Guard', trigger 'issues' with types:[opened] only, single job 'lint' on ubuntu-latest using Node.js 18 via actions/setup-node, steps in order actions/checkout -> npm ci -> npm run lint.
steps.source: description.md Requirements[2]; verify.py required_snippets + step-ordering check (checkout < setup-node < npm ci < npm run lint)

steps.description: Open a pull request titled 'Add issue lint workflow' and get it merged so the workflow file exists on main.

After the merge, open a new issue titled 'Lint workflow check' to trigger the workflow via the issues:opened event, and wait until the matching Issue Lint Guard run finishes with conclusion 'success'.
steps.source: description.md Requirements[4]; verify.py _wait_for_tracking_issue_run (polls workflow runs for display_title=='Lint workflow check', requires status=='completed' and conclusion=='success')
